tools.name: ato_whoami
tools.description: Returns the caller identity (AssigneeId/Role/AiModel) resolved from the configured API key.

tools.name: ato_resume
tools.description: Resumes this assignee open work: in_progress/changes_requested/qa_rejected tasks + last 10 events.

tools.name: ato_task_context
tools.description: Full detail for a task: acceptance criteria, ContextSnapshot, timeline, evidence, comments.

taskId.description: Task key, typed (e.g. AF-HU-12) or legacy (e.g. AF-80), or GUID.

tools.name: ato_comment
tools.description: Post a comment/suggestion/question/objection/reply on a task (never changes status).

taskId.description: Task key, typed (e.g. AF-HU-12) or legacy (e.g. AF-80), or GUID.

tools.name: ato_debate
tools.description: List the comment/debate thread for a task.

taskId.description: Task key, typed (e.g. AF-HU-12) or legacy (e.g. AF-80), or GUID.

tools.name: ato_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a task (name, type, size, purpose, who uploaded it, fileId). Use ato_fetch_attachment to read one.

taskId.description: Task key, typed (e.g. AF-HU-12) or legacy (e.g. AF-80), or GUID.

tools.name: ato_fetch_attachment
tools.description: Download an attached file by fileId into a local folder (default: a temp folder) and return its path, so you can open a mockup or read an evidence file.
